Database._comment: Postgres | SqlServer. Switch both this and ConnectionStrings:Default together.

Tokari._comment: Local Tokari (external port). SigningKey is a secret: dotnet user-secrets set Tokari:SigningKey <Tokari's JwtSettings:SigningKey>.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Local dev only — a throwaway local Postgres instance, never a real credential. docker-compose overrides this via ConnectionStrings__Default for the containerized run.
